Casual or low-stakes choices.
If the decision does not justify
assembling documents,
the product is overhead.
We say so in the pitch.

span.p:
Security lead / eng manager / founder

Handed a vendor decision and a folder of PDFs.
Three vendors. Four documents each. Thursday.

span.p:
THE SHARED CONSTRAINT
The work is exactly what an agent should do,
and exactly what people refuse to let an agent do.
Consensus removes the choice.
